scripts.build:core:win: cd ../proxy-core && cross-env GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o proxy-core.exe .
scripts.build:core:win:arm64: cd ../proxy-core && cross-env GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o proxy-core.exe .
scripts.build:core:linux: cd ../proxy-core && cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o proxy-core .
scripts.build:core:linux:arm64: cd ../proxy-core && cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o proxy-core .
scripts.build:core:mac: cd ../proxy-core && cross-env GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o proxy-core .
scripts.build:core:mac:x64: cd ../proxy-core && cross-env GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o proxy-core .
scripts.electron:dev: npm run build:core && concurrently -k "npm run dev:renderer" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run dev:electron"
scripts.electron:build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
scripts.dist: npm run build:core && npm run electron:build && electron-builder
scripts.dist:win: npm run build:core:win && npm run electron:build && cross-env PP_CORE_BIN=proxy-core.exe electron-builder --win --x64
scripts.dist:win:arm64: npm run build:core:win:arm64 && npm run electron:build && cross-env PP_CORE_BIN=proxy-core.exe electron-builder --win --arm64
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build:core:linux && npm run electron:build && cross-env PP_CORE_BIN=proxy-core electron-builder --linux --x64
scripts.dist:linux:arm64: npm run build:core:linux:arm64 && npm run electron:build && cross-env PP_CORE_BIN=proxy-core electron-builder --linux --arm64
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build:core:mac && npm run electron:build && cross-env PP_CORE_BIN=proxy-core electron-builder --mac --arm64
scripts.dist:mac:x64: npm run build:core:mac:x64 && npm run electron:build && cross-env PP_CORE_BIN=proxy-core electron-builder --mac --x64
